countsMean.frames: The sweep's own frame count, asserted by `check-evidence.mjs` against the frames on disk that fall outside any declared `supplementary` set - 594 at this merge, and the assertion is the definition rather than a restatement of it: 681 `.webp` are committed and the fourteen `supplementary` sets below account for 87 of them, leaving 594 - the `chat-title` set's sixteen frames are the addition, so the sweep's own term is unmoved by it. The arithmetic against the two sides of the merge, which is where the number comes from rather than from a sweep that was never re-run: this branch carried 546 swept frames and main carried 574, and the two are not additive - main's 48 `chat-older-history-slot` frames (4 boards x 12 themes, #112) are the only swept frames this side did not have, so the merged sweep is 546 + 48. The declared sets grew the same way: main's thirteen are this branch's twelve plus `transcript-scroll-paging`, whose seven live frames are already on disk, and the `chat-title` set is a later addition from the untitled-header fix (sixteen frames from the built app, declared with its own provenance below and therefore outside this count by construction). `check-evidence.mjs` is what confirms both terms; the figures are recorded here because a reader who cannot re-derive them has no way to tell a reconciled manifest from one that was edited until the gate passed. **Added by the model-picker feedback fix.** Twelve swept stories (`chat-model-picker--*`, eleven, and `chat-session-status-strip--model-switch-pending`) are 144 frames of the 738, so the swept term is 594 + 144; the fifteen declared sets now account for 103 of the 841 `.webp` on disk (87 + this change's eighteen), which is what leaves 738. Every one of the 144 is a state of the picker or of the band across all twelve themes, because the row's ground is a class the palette gate cannot see: `bg-sunken` on `bg-elevated` is asserted as an adjacent pair in every theme, while the `bg-accent-wash` the sibling popup uses collapses onto `elevated` in obsidian (ΔE00 0.77). **Added by the model-picker remediation round.** The declared `model-picker-feedback` set grew from 18 frames to 25 in the remediation round (nine paired states kept, seven after-only states added) and to 26 in the U7 round (one frame replaced in place, one `before-*` half added), so the swept term is unchanged at 738 and the set's own count is what moved: 851 `.webp` are on disk, 113 of them inside the fifteen declared sets and twenty-six inside this one, which is the assertion `check-evidence.mjs` makes against the tree rather than against this sentence. These frames were captured from the WORKING TREE that the remediation commit contains, which is why the capture itself recorded `dirtyWorkingTree: true`; the commit's trees are what `srcTree`/`scriptsTree` name.
countsMean.surfaces: `capture-evidence.mjs`'s `STORIES.length` at the head above - 95 entries, counted off the merged literal rather than summed from the two sides' fields (91 and 85, each written by a run taken before the other side landed). The four this merge adds are main's `chat-older-history-slot--app-minimum-width`, `--every-state`, `--one-hidden-row` and `--transport-down` boards (#112). `check-evidence.mjs` counts the list and fails a mismatch (round 4, R3), so this field cannot silently lag its own source again. **Added by the model-picker feedback fix.** The list gained twelve: eleven `chat-model-picker--*` states (populated, hovered, keyboard-highlight, busy, result, persist-checked, refresh-pending, loading, empty, partial-error, narrow) and one band state, `chat-session-status-strip--model-switch-pending`, so `STORIES.length` reads 107 and `check-evidence.mjs` counts it off the committed list rather than trusting this field. **Added by the model-picker remediation round.** `STORIES` is unchanged at 107: the remediation added no story, because every state it needed was already a story (`chat-model-picker--hovered` and `--busy` carry the new structural mark, and `chat-session-status-strip--model-switch-pending` carries the labelled spinner), and the seven genuinely new states live in the live-app set above, where a scroll offset, a click and an answer that arrives after the dialog is gone are expressible.

supplementary.source: the REAL built Electron app (`pnpm build`, then `docs/evidence/window-mode/harness/run.sh` with EXTRA_SEED=seed-model-picker.mjs and DRIVE_SCRIPT=drive-model-picker.mjs, headless, 1380x900) against an isolated `local-operator serve` on a port the script owns, 0 frontmost samples in every run and 0 renderer errors. Sixteen states, and they come from TWO runs because two starting states are needed: fifteen from the branch's own seed (no provider credential, i.e. the refusal path — the seed the `before-*` halves were taken under, so the pairs still differ by the change and not by the setup), and the three `needs-sign-in-*` frames from a second run on QA's credentialed seed (`/tmp/qa130/seed-qa.mjs`, a synthetic `openai` credential written through the backend's own AuthStore) — without a credential the owner refuses every switch, so a switch it ACCEPTS does not exist there. The second run's frames are prefixed `cred-` by the driver so no frame can be mistaken for the other seed's. `localOperatorDark` is the app's own default theme, which is the only theme the harness boots into. **U7 round.** The one frame UX U7 invalidated was re-captured on the fixed head and one `before-*` half was added beside it: `needs-sign-in-pick-settled` now shows `This session runs anthropic/claude-opus-5.` (the row the check is on) where the pre-fix frame showed `openai/gpt-4.1`, and that pre-fix frame is committed as `before-header-names-the-switch` — the only `before-*` half taken on this branch's own pre-fix head (`ccbeb0e2a`) rather than on the merge-base, because UX filed U7 against the branch rather than against the base. That run is also the first whose cache lives inside the scratch root: `run.sh` now sets `HOME="$SCRATCH/home"` (QA round 2, Q3 — the catalogue cache resolves from `HOME`, not from the config dir), so the seed copies the same `*.listing.json` files the earlier run read into the scratch home, and nothing outside `/tmp` is written. Both runs' measurements are committed beside the frames (`picker-metrics.json`, `picker-metrics-credentialed.json`), so every number the README quotes is re-derivable from the tree.
supplementary.why: the claim is that a hover, a keyboard highlight, an in-flight pick and the OUTCOME of that pick are perceivable — properties of computed style and of timing that no palette assertion and no component test can see. The unit suite asserts the classes, the transitions and the reading rule (`scripts/picker-feedback.test.mjs`); only a frame of the running app shows the ground and the edge the row actually paints inside a dialog whose own ground is `elevated`, and what the user is left with when the answer arrives after the dialog is gone. The `before-*` halves carry the defect as a measurement: the active row's computed background is `rgb(40,35,24)`, identical to the dialog's, and `before-pointer-left-list` is byte-identical to `before-keyboard-highlight` (AE 0 of 4,813,440 px). Seven of the sixteen states are after-only, and that is the finding rather than an omission: each is a state the old code could not produce or could not report — the pointer's structural edge in a palette where the wash collapses (D12), the footer naming the row Enter acts on while that row is off screen (U1), the band holding a labelled spinner while the pick is unconfirmed (U3), the refusal landing with the dialog already closed (U2), and the three `needs-sign-in-*` frames (Q1). The transcript note count is measured either side of the U2 case — 1 before the click, 2 after it, with the dialog closed 80 ms in — because the refusal sentence is identical for every refused pick and only a count can prove a second one was written. The U7 pair is measured rather than described: between the two frames AE is 85,307 px (1.77%) of 4,813,440, of which 13,230 px (2% fuzz) sit in one 952x64 band across the header sentence's own text line and 274 px are the clock.
